title: Continuous cohomology commutes with unions of finite submodules
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group, $\ell$ a prime, and $M$ a discrete continuous $\ell$-primary $G$-module. Let $\{M_i\}$ be the directed system of all finite $G$-stable submodules of $M$, ordered by inclusion; it has union $M$. For every integer $q\geq0$, the canonical map $\varinjlim_i H^q(G,M_i)\to H^q(G,M)$ for continuous cohomology (computed by the continuous cochain complex in [def-exc-continuous-cohomology]) is an isomorphism.
